opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: £56,000 in year one, £28,000 in years two‑three, up to £6,000 per annum for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must not yet have held a full‑time permanent academic post in a UK university, must hold a doctorate, must have submitted their doctoral thesis for viva by the closing date, must be resident in the UK and must not be currently registered for a degree or professional qualification.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work, with joint funding of salary (up to £56k year 1, £28k years 2‑3) and up to £6k per year for research expenses.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities and other UK higher‑education institutions are eligible; on a trial basis UK‑based independent research institutes/organisations are also eligible.
opportunities.summary: Funds innovative and original research projects (up to five years) across all subject areas, with a maximum award of £500,000.
discipline_tags: All subject areas (excluding medical/clinical, policy‑driven, commercial, database‑focused research)

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Application must be made by a member of academic staff at a UK university with research degree awarding powers; the host institution must administer the grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports UK institutions to invite eminent senior overseas professors for 3‑12 months to bring novel expertise and enhance skills of staff and students.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary replacement (starting at junior lecturer scale) plus up to £6,000 per annum for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well‑established, distinguished researchers in the humanities and social sciences employed at an eligible UK university.
opportunities.summary: Provides two‑ or three‑year fellowships for established researchers to complete a piece of original research, with salary replacement and research expense funding.
discipline_tags: Humanities and social sciences (excluding medical/clinical research)

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK university appointment (lecturer level or equivalent), at least two years post‑PhD experience, who have not previously led a research team or held comparable leadership awards.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career scholars to build and lead a modest research team, developing research leadership over a 4‑5‑year period.
discipline_tags: All research areas (excluding medical/clinical, policy‑driven, advocacy, commercial, database‑focused research)
